personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 4 Tactile radius and spacing
personality_one_liner: A professional yet friendly SaaS management tool for pet businesses, anchored in calm botanical tones, soft rounded cards, and generous whitespace.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room and clear padding inside cards to ensure content doesn't feel cramped. Ensure safe-area padding at screen roots.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
dont's: Do not blur individual list rows
Do not apply to body content

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A quick operational overview for the busy professional, showing today's revenue and immediate upcoming appointments.

states.empty: Illustration of a calendar/dog with 'No appointments scheduled for today' and a primary CTA to 'Add Booking'.
states.error: Readable message about failing to load data + Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Hello, [Name]' and date. Top section: Revenue summary cards arranged in a 2-column flex grid (width calculated with gap). Middle section: 'Today's Appointments' list with color-coded left borders or pills indicating status (Confirmed, Completed). Bottom: Pinned FAB or sticky bottom CTA for 'Quick Add Booking' floating over a glass container.

screens.name: Pet Profiles
screens.purpose: The hero feature providing an in-depth view of a specific pet's health, history, and special requirements.

states.loading: Skeleton loader matching the profile structure.
states.empty: Not applicable for a detail screen (would be 404/not found state).

screens.layout: Top: Full-width hero image of the pet. **MANDATORY**: Apply a top-to-bottom linear-gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) over the image. Overlay pet Name and Breed at the bottom 30% of this hero area in onSurfaceInverse. Below hero: A horizontal scroll or grid of stats (Age, Weight, Breed). Followed by pillowy rounded cards for 'Medical Notes', 'Allergies', and 'Vaccination Status' (using status colors subtly). Bottom section: Timeline of 'Customer History / Appointments'.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Manage daily and weekly schedules with clear visual blocks.

states.empty: Empty state graphic indicating a free schedule.

screens.layout: Top: Weekday selector (segmented control or horizontal date list). Below: Time-blocked list of appointments. Each appointment card shows pet name, service, time, and a status badge.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Gather business information to set up the professional SaaS environment.
screens.layout: Single column form. Labels above inputs. Progress indicator at the top. Pinned primary 'Continue' CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Subscription
screens.purpose: Gate premium features behind a paywall after the 14-day free trial.
screens.layout: Centered pricing tier card ('£12.99/month') using brandTertiary tint. Feature list below with checkmarks. Sticky bottom CTA 'Start 14-Day Free Trial'.

hero_pet_profile.alt: A smiling golden retriever sitting in the grass

secondary_pet.alt: An adult Boston terrier/French bulldog looking up

grooming_action.alt: Black and white short coated dog

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the defined palette strictly: Use surface (#FDFBF7) for background, and brand (#526A5A, Sage green) for primary actions. DO NOT use indigo, blue, or purple anywhere in the UI.
Implement rounded pillowy cards using the lg (20) radius token to achieve the modern, friendly SaaS look requested.

For the Pet Profiles hero section, YOU MUST implement a vertical linear-gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) layered directly above the expo-image and below the text content to ensure WCAG AA readability for the pet's name/breed.
Ensure safe-area spacing at the root of every screen, and ensure all Pressable touch targets are ≥44x44pt.
For scrolling screens with a primary action (e.g., Quick Add Booking, Start Trial), use the sticky primary CTA pattern anchored at the bottom (outside the ScrollView) to ensure quick reachability.
For data lists, ensure minimum 56pt height and include Loading, Empty, and Error states filling the flex area.
Use Phosphor icons consistently; do not mix icon sets or weights.
Learning from research: Multi-pet tracking should use circular avatars. Dashboard UI should include clear revenue summary blocks and color-coded weekly day selectors for scheduling.
